subscription.title: Plans
subscription.intro: Every plan works on gifos.app/meet. Public open-floor meetings are always free.
subscription.upgradeNow: A bigger plan replaces yours. Its first charge is smaller: we take off a credit for the unused time of your current plan. Every charge after that is the full price.
subscription.upgradeCancel: We cancel the plan it replaces as soon as the new one starts, so you are never billed twice.
subscription.upgradePass: A four-hour pass is never cancelled: it keeps running beside any plan.
subscription.fileNote: Your plan lives in this browser. Keep a copy: download your subscription file here, or choose Use on another device on gifos.app/subscription.
subscription.heldNone: This browser holds no plan: you have Free.
subscription.heldSubEnds: This browser holds {plan}. It is cancelled and ends on {until}.
subscription.heldPass: A four-hour pass is on until {until}.
subscription.heldPassNever: A pass with no end is on.
subscription.thanks: Thank you. Your new plan is on.
subscription.notConfirmed: PayPal did not confirm the payment.
subscription.passThanks: Thank you. Your four-hour pass is on.
subscription.broadcast: Get it in the Broadcast app
subscription.agreePre: By paying you agree to the
subscription.charges: Charges show as Crowd Concepts (the company behind GifOS).
subscription.free.name: Free
subscription.free.desc: Hosted meetings of up to 5 people, voice through our relay servers, one meeting at a time.
subscription.pass.name: Four-hour pass
subscription.pass.desc: Unlimited for 4 hours in one meeting at a time, without taking charge of open-floor meetings.
subscription.room20.name: Room 20
subscription.room20.desc: Hosted meetings of up to 20 people, video through our relay servers, one meeting at a time.
subscription.unlimited.name: Unlimited
subscription.unlimited.desc: Hosted meetings with no people limit, video through our relay servers, taking charge of open-floor meetings, one meeting at a time.
subscription.streamer.name: Streamer
subscription.streamer.desc: Everything in Unlimited, plus My library for recordings and transcripts. Sold in the Broadcast app.
subscription.family.name: Family business
subscription.family.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 5 meetings at once.
subscription.smallBusiness.name: Small business
subscription.smallBusiness.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 10 meetings at once.
subscription.business.name: Business
subscription.business.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 100 meetings at once.
subscription.enterprise.name: Enterprise
subscription.enterprise.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 10,000 meetings at once. A yearly plan billed monthly.
subscription.negotiated.name: Negotiated
subscription.negotiated.desc: More than 10,000 meetings at once, on terms we agree with you.
subscription.upgradeRule: A yearly plan can move only to a bigger yearly plan. A monthly plan can move to a bigger monthly or yearly plan.
subscription.upgradeStack: Plans add up: a pass or an add-on you hold counts on top of your plan, so their meetings at once add together.
subscription.perMonth12: {price} a month for 12 months ({year} a year)
subscription.notUpgrade: Not an upgrade of your plan
subscription.largeBusiness.name: Large business
subscription.largeBusiness.desc: Everything in Unlimited, in up to 1,000 meetings at once.
subscription.hostedBot.name: Hosted bot
subscription.hostedBot.desc: Add-on: one bot we run for you in your meetings, on top of any plan.
subscription.pmMeetingsNone: This plan is not in a meeting right now
subscription.pmMoveHow: Start or join the meeting on this device; you will be asked which meeting gives up its place.
subscription.pmCodeBad: Code did not match. Start again.
subscription.pmSent: Sent. The other device can use your plan now.
subscription.pmRecvLead: Type this code on the device that has your plan
subscription.pmRecvDone: Done: this device now uses your plan
subscription.pmReplace: Replace the plan on this device?
subscription.pmReplaceNo: Keep the plan on this device
subscription.pmRestoreQ: Move {plan} here? Your other devices stop using it.
subscription.pmLibWarn: Your library opens only on a device that still has your old plan file or that you move the plan from.
subscription.pmSignoutAsk: Sign out every other device? This device keeps the plan. The others stop until you move it again or restore it.
subscription.pmFailed: That did not work. Start again.
subscription.pmSaved: Saved. Keep it private: anyone with the file can use your plan.
subscription.pmSignedOut: Other devices are signed out. This device still has your plan.
subscription.pmCancelled: Your plan is cancelled. It runs until it ends.
